notablePrerequisites: You have at least one red card in hand.
description:
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Horde Ambusher, adding {C}{C}.
When Horde Ambusher dies, Yedora triggers, returning Horde Ambusher from your graveyard to the battlefield face down as a Forest land.
Activate Horde Ambusher by tapping it, adding {G}.
Activate Horde Ambusher's morph ability by revealing a red card from your hand, turning it face up.
Repeat.
